newsitem.title: INDIA: India says donors pledge $6.7 billion in aid.
newsitem.headline: India says donors pledge $6.7 billion in aid.

text.p: India said that international donors meeting in Paris on Wednesday pledged some $6.7 billion in aid to support the nation's economic reforms, about the same as last year's $6.6 billion.

The government said in a statement released in New Delhi that "India's economic reforms received strong support and endorsement from the community of bilateral and multilateraal donors assembled in Paris".
The annual India Development Forum meetings on Tuesday and Wednesday in Paris were held under the aegis of the World Bank.
They were attended by representatives of the Asian Development Bank, the European Commission and the International Monetary Fund.

The $6.7-billion pledge was in line with the expectations of Indian officials, who said the country had stepped up utilisation of external assistance in the 1996/97 fiscal year that ended on March 31.
